description: This file contains utility extension methods for Orleans testing, including a timeout wrapper for tasks and a method to generate local silo addresses.

classes.name: TestExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for testing, including a timeout wrapper for tasks.

classes.name: SiloAddressUtils
classes.description: Provides utility methods for creating silo addresses, specifically local silo addresses.

methods.name: WithTimeout
methods.description: An extension method that adds a timeout to a Task, throwing a TimeoutException if the task does not complete within the specified duration.

methods.name: NewLocalSiloAddress
methods.description: Creates a new local SiloAddress with a specified generation number.
